description: This file is a header file defining an interface for component management functions in a C project. It includes function prototypes for setting parameters, enabling/disabling components, getting and adding instances, and manipulating string parameters via CSV. The file also includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: component_set_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a specified component.

methods.name: component_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified component.

methods.name: component_set_str_param
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a specified component.

methods.name: component_set_params
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a specified component using a var_t array.

methods.name: component_get_path_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the path instance of a component based on a query.

methods.name: component_add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new component instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: component_del_instance
methods.description: Deletes a component instance based on its path.

methods.name: component_get_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a component.

methods.name: component_add_string_to_csv
methods.description: Adds a string to a CSV list parameter of a component.

methods.name: component_remove_string_from_csv
methods.description: Removes a string from a CSV list parameter of a component.
